description: §7.3.1 — a nested function's scope is the body that declares it: `helper`, declared inside `host`, is not in scope in `outside` — the call there names no declared function (E-SCOPE-001).
rationale: §7.3.1: 'The compiler SHALL NOT hoist inner function declarations out of their enclosing function body. Each inner function's scope is the enclosing function body, not the `${}` block.'
